fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole jonboat with motor and trailer.
findings: Painted olive hull sides and interior look clean and evenly colored in all photos
Johnson outboard cowling looks clean and white with no obvious chalking
A few leaves and light debris on the floor and bench area inside the boat
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Lowe jonboat and Johnson rig. It already looks well kept, with clean paint on the hull and a bright motor cowling. If you want it extra sharp for buyers, we can come to you for a quick wash, wipe-down of the interior and a coat of protectant on the hull and cowling. Would you like a quote?
